description: Simulator lifecycle and interaction ownership rules for Phase 3 UI automation

single_owner_rule.description: One run = one simulator lifecycle and interaction owner. The single owner may hold BOTH review devices (iPhone 17 Pro iOS 26.5 primary + iPhone 16 Pro iOS 18.x minimum-version). All other tools disabled or restricted to read-only no-simulator tasks.

review_devices.note: Same build artifact installed on both devices; identical fixture and launch argument for consistent review state.

conflict_detection.note: Dual review devices (17 Pro + 16 Pro) held by the SAME owner are legitimate and do NOT constitute a conflict. Conflict = same device controlled by multiple runs/owners.
